title: Spaghetti with Anchovies and Taralli Crumbs
author: Lorenzo
description: Anchovies melted in garlic oil, topped with crushed taralli for crunch.
steps: Toast the crushed taralli in a dry pan until golden and set aside.
Boil the spaghetti in lightly salted water (the anchovies are salty).
Gently warm the oil with the garlic and chili, add the anchovies and stir until they melt.
Toss the pasta in the pan with a splash of its water, then finish with parsley, lemon zest and the taralli crumbs.
